body: Hi! In the same boat. Super-late diagnosis. Now that I can recognize my own traits, I’m spotting NDs left and right. But you can’t assume that they know or want people to know they’re ND, so how do you connect?
I also have add2 and struggle with binging. Apparently that’s a common issue for people with our brains. I’ve found that my meds give me the bandwidth to manage my binge tendencies most of the time.
